items.title: Edward "Eddie" Richardson Interview, 1960-10-29
items.q: Marjorie Zander is identified only as the interviewer ('>> [Marjorie Zander] Marjorie Zander.') and no personal or professional relationship with the interviewee is described.

ctx.x: First thing I want to do is get everybody's name down. What's your name? Edward Richardson. Mm-hmm.

Dick Allen. I see. Where were you born, Richardson? In New Orleans. What section? They call it the battlefield. That's over around Lafayette and Cypress. Lafayette and Cypress. Yeah. You know I forgot to put today's date on this thing and what are we doing on it? See we're recording in the library in Seminar Room 2, Tulane University. And what's today's date? October the, I can't think. 29th I believe. October the 29th, 1960. So you were born around Cypress and Lafayette, that's your neighborhood? That's right.…
